base_source: median_of_last_3_fy_oe_per_share from EDGAR 10-K (OCF - capex - SBC): FY24 $0.72, FY25 $0.95, FY26 $0.19 -> median $0.72/share. Latest FY is distorted down by a pulled-forward capex spike ($277.3M, 8.3% of revenue; at FY25 capex FY26 OE would be ~$0.90/share). FY ended only ~2.4 months before the run (no STALE_FY) and Q1 FY27 has not reported, so no TTM override applies.
moat_justification: Zero Trust Exchange architecture with real enterprise switching costs (#1 ZTNA-as-a-service, #2 SASE; 785 customers >$1M ARR, ~115% net retention, telemetry scale) and working land-and-expand into data security / AI security / SecOps — against platformization and bundling by Palo Alto, CrowdStrike, Fortinet and Microsoft, no endpoint/firewall base, unproven pricing power (growth guided down to ~17%, RPO decelerating three straight quarters), and rising data-center capex intensity.
name: Zscaler Inc.
one_liner: Category-defining zero-trust platform, moat 6/10 — but SBC is $822M (25% of revenue, $5.13/share), so normalized owner's earnings are $0.72/share (a 0.3% yield) against a $224.50 price; weighted IRR 3.3% with IV@15% of $11.14, it clears 15% only below ~$11 (~$8 with a margin of safety), and even treating SBC as free leaves IV@15% at ~$82.
